methodology: Same fixed prompts run through both models in the same engine process: per-call wall latency includes prompt evaluation + decode; tok/s = completion tokens / wall latency. Throughput: 5 runs of the error-correction prompt, max_tokens 64, temperature 0.2. Accuracy: 6 shared MCQs (3 quantum, 3 bioinformatics), temperature 0, max_tokens 256; correct if the expected answer phrase appears in the response. Note per-call end-to-end tok/s reports effective throughput incl. variable R1 thinking preamble, so it is lower than the earlier pure-decode quantization figures; both models are compared on the identical, router-less (expert=general) harness for apples-to-apples.
